description: Read any public page of bettrails.com as clean text: eSoccer players and head-to-heads, today's matches and results (/hoy, /resultados), records, rankings (/jugadores), and the esports and basketball sections: /lol, /dota, /cs2, /valorant, /basket (hubs, leagues, today, teams, players, matches with preview or result, tournaments, champions, heroes, agents, maps, countries, records). Covers these topics in text and tables; the links on each page (shown as [/path]) can be read too. Useful starting points: /hoy (eSoccer today), /lol/hoy, /dota/hoy, /cs2/hoy, /valorant/hoy, /basket/hoy, /lol/worlds, /jugadores (eSoccer ELO ranking), /records. Pages of a specific player, team, champion or tournament can be found with search. Content is statistics only (no odds, no betting).

language.description: Language of the bettrails.com links returned (normally the language of the conversation). Default: es.

path.description: Page path or full bettrails.com URL, e.g. "/valorant/hoy" or "/basket/ggl/jugador/archer".

name: read_page
title: Read a Bettrails page
